title: K80 GPU v72 start callback lock-order snapshot
status: offline source/build candidate; unselected, unpackaged, and unbooted
change: The BoardOwner GPU start callback now snapshots retained InactiveOwner/RegisterMaps pointers under the BoardOwner startup lock, drops that lock before checking map/provider identity, then reacquires the lock and confirms both pointers are unchanged before continuing the one-shot owner-state checks. BoardOwner retains the parent/map references after successful MMU startup; the map check itself revalidates provider claims before and after its protected identity comparison.
